$comment: Ravenford quest definitions (ADR 0025 §2; owner decisions of 2026-10-04). The Missing Caravan is a projection of the party's own records, memories, movements, examinations, and fights: it activates when the party first holds a record or memory of its own about the guild caravan (Mira's account), not on the public rumor, and completes when, after the return, a member shows Mira Vale the party's evidence about the caravan (Stage 530). Summaries are what players read; they name nothing the party has not met by then.
